描述_EN: gold and silver were not as highly coveted in china as in other ancient civilisations such as the roman or the parthian, but they came to play a more central role in chinese society by the beginning of the tang dynasty (ad 618-907) when frequent trade contacts between china and its western neighbours developed along the silk road. this cup was probably used to drink alcohol and clearly shows how foreign shapes were imitated during the tang dynasty. chinese goldsmiths often imitated the foreign shapes and styles of the imported goods and developed new techniques under the influence of central asian craftsmen who had settled in chinese urban centers beginning in the mid 7th century.
描述_ZN: 在中国，金银并不像其他古代文明如罗马或帕提亚那样受到高度重视，但到了唐朝（公元618-907年）开始，它们在中国社会中发挥了更重要的作用，当时中国和西方邻国之间的贸易往来沿着丝绸之路频繁发展。 这个杯子可能是用来饮酒的，清楚地显示了唐朝时对外国形状的模仿。 中国的金匠们经常模仿外国进口货物的形状和风格，并在7世纪中叶开始在中国城市中心定居的中亚工匠的影响下发展了新的技术。
